verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government intellectual-property office offering trademark, patent and design filing, search, and bulk-data services. Hosting user-authored automations with versioning, review, and rollback is outside that product category. Nothing in the evidence shows CIPO ships any automation-authoring capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
